02 · Brand health

Know what the market says about you, before it becomes a problem.

Brand health is not a quarterly survey. It is a continuous signal, already public: what your customers say about you, the words they repeat, the subjects that attach to your name. The work is to read it in time, and to tell the noise from what matters.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between online reputation and brand health?

Online reputation looks at what is said about you. Brand health adds who says it, with what influence, and how it moves against your competitors. That second level is what lets you decide.

How fast are you alerted?

Monitoring runs 24/7, and alerts go out within 15 minutes, in more than twenty languages, with an escalation protocol agreed with you.

Do you replace our monitoring tool?

Not necessarily. If you already have a platform, we can make it produce decisions. If not, the licence is ours.
